title: Law No. 444 of 29 July 2002 on Environmental Protection (قانون حماية البيئة)
citation: Law No. 444 of 29/07/2002, Official Gazette issue 44, 08/08/2002, p. 5369
evidence: Opened https://legallaw.ul.edu.lb/Law.aspx?lawId=244662&language=ar and its print view on 2026-11-03. Header: "الجريدة الرسمية العدد 44 تاريخ النشر 08/08/2002". Art. 68: "يعمل بهذا القانون فور نشره في الجريدة الرسمية."
notes: Environmental framework act: general principles, environmental impact assessment and compliance of establishments (implemented by lb-decree-8471-2012). The database lists no amendment text in the print view that was read; no consolidation is served. Some sources date the law 8 August 2002 (it is cited that way in Decree 8471/2012); the date of signature on the text is 29 July 2002. title: Law No. 78 of 13 April 2018 on Air Quality Protection (قانون حماية نوعية الهواء)
citation: Law No. 78 of 13/04/2018, Official Gazette issue 18, 19/04/2018, pp. 2707-2720
evidence: Opened https://legallaw.ul.edu.lb/Law.aspx?lawId=275522&language=ar and its print view on 2026-11-03. Header: "الجريدة الرسمية العدد 18 تاريخ النشر 19/04/2018 الصفحة 2707-2720". Art. 33: "تاريخ العمل بالقانون . يعمل بهذا القانون فور نشره في الجريدة الرسمية."
notes: Carries the air emissions reporting duty: private-sector data holders must provide available air-quality data to the Ministry of Environment and the ministry keeps a national emissions inventory (family kept from the register row). Related on the database page: Circular 19/2019 (data validation of the national air quality monitoring network) and Decree 14459/2024 (lb-decree-14459-2024). The Ministry of Environment list dates the law 21 May 2018, which is the date it was posted on the ministry site. title: Law No. 659 of 4 February 2005 on Consumer Protection (قانون حماية المستهلك)
citation: Law No. 659 of 04/02/2005, Official Gazette issue 6, 10/02/2005, pp. 426-451
evidence: Opened https://legallaw.ul.edu.lb/Law.aspx?lawId=245560&language=ar and its print view on 2026-11-03. Header: "الجريدة الرسمية العدد 6 تاريخ النشر 10/02/2005". Art. 132: "ينشر هذا القانون ويعمل به بعد انقضاء مهلة ثلاثة أشهر تلي تاريخ نشره في الجريدة الرسمية." Three months after 10 February 2005 gives 10 May 2005. The parliamentary preamble line "يعمل بهذا القانون فور نشره" is not the promulgated article and is not used.
notes: Umbrella consumer law: Chapter 4 (Arts. 11 to 14) prohibits misleading advertising. The text read contains no rule on environmental claims as such; it is listed as the general basis under which a misleading environmental claim to consumers could fall. Amendment history not read. title: Decree No. 8471 of 4 July 2012 on Environmental Compliance of Establishments (الالتزام البيئي للمنشآت)
citation: Decree No. 8471 of 04/07/2012, Official Gazette issue 30, 12/07/2012, pp. 3310-3313; republished in issue 31, 19/07/2012, pp. 3426-3447
evidence: Opened https://legallaw.ul.edu.lb/Law.aspx?lawId=232573&language=ar and its print view on 2026-11-03. Art. 13: "يعمل بهذا المرسوم فور نشره في الجريدة الرسمية." First publication per the database entry for lawId 232435: issue 30, 12/07/2012; the republished text (lawId 232573, issue 31, 19/07/2012) is the one linked.
notes: Implements Law 444/2002 Arts. 12 and 13: environmental compliance certificates (valid three years), self environmental audits and environmental management for classified establishments. First in-force date is the first publication (12 July 2012); the republication of 19 July 2012 is not treated as a new date.
